description: This file defines various enums and types representing different icon states and roles in a SwiftUI application, specifically for handling activity states, icon states, and override selections related to a graphical user interface.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Provides the symbol name associated with the current icon state's activity.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Determines the prominence level for the badge based on the icon state.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the icon state is in a working activity besides idle.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection into a corresponding icon state.
